correctness.rationale: For occupancy probability psi, initial conditional detection pi, transitions a=P(1|0), b=P(1|1), expansion of the seven nonzero histories gives u=psi*pi and r=psi*(1-pi)*a. Thus b=(q110+q111)/u, a=q101/(q100+q101), psi=u+r/a, pi=u/psi. Positivity makes divisions safe. The remaining three independent algebraic equalities q111=ub², q011=rb and q001=r(1-a), with reconstructed parameters in (0,1), are both necessary and sufficient for an interior eight-cell history law, with q000 by normalization. Two-wave observations determine only (u,r,b), leaving a free interior interval and infinitely many quadruples. Independently tested 256 exact rational parameter quadruples and the analytic inversion; this proves an ideal population-law identification theorem, not finite-sample estimation.
